data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-b-d' which means 'to flow like a river' or 'to pour out'. The name Lubaid is a masculine name meaning 'lion-like' or 'brave warrior'. It is a name of great significance in Islamic history and is often given to boys as a symbol of courage and strength. The name Lubaid carries the meaning “Lion-like, Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lubaid usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-like, brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Al-Lubaid ibn Qatada (d. 716 CE), was an early Islamic scholar and a student of Ibn Abbas. He is known for his collections of Hadith and his commentary on the Quran. He was born in Medina and spent much of his life in Kufa, where he was a teacher and imam. He was a strong proponent of the Sunni doctrine and is considered one of the early scholars of the Shafi'i school of Islamic law.

He was born in Damascus and rose to prominence through his military prowess and his loyalty to the Abbasid Caliphate.
